name: Vaseline Lip Therapy Jelly Original 20g
description:
Product details of Vaseline Lip Therapy Jelly Original – 20g

Product Type: Lip Balm / Lip Therapy

Size: 20g

Origin: Made in Poland

Key Features:

Protects & Relieves: Heals dry, chapped lips while locking in essential moisture

Instant Soothing Effect: Softens and comforts lips instantly

Moisture Lock: Helps lips recover from dryness and discomfort

Triple-Purified Jelly: Gentle, safe, and effective lip care formula

Best For: Chapped lips & dry skin
